title: Boots on the step
logline: Two days after the editor's visit in the box's order: a pair of clean boots on the garage step beside the pup's bowl, and the alley wet. The visitor's, before the strip. The page draws the boots as the person, as the strip did the hat.

panels.composition: A pair of clean leather boots on a garage's concrete step beside a dog's water bowl, the alley wet beyond, the door ajar.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a pair of clean leather boots on a garage's concrete step beside a dog's water bowl with a wet alley beyond and the door ajar, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
